Look-in option

A look-in option is available for 48 hours from the time of booking, during which the booking can be changed or cancelled without a change or cancellation fee. Any fare difference is payable. Not available for domestic flights departing within 7 days of booking.

Call centre cancellations attract an additional fee of up to INR 500 per person per sector, over and above the cancellation fee.
